title: Living reptilians from a crash were shot
summary: unidentified clip speaker tells of Living reptilians from a crash were shot, about undated at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> Do you know what supposedly happened to those living reptilians from the crash? >> Uh uh deceased. They were killed.

plain: In a clip shown on a podcast episode about a former US energy secretary, an unnamed speaker is asked what happened to living reptile-like beings said to have survived the crash of a craft. He answers that they died, that they were killed. If true, it would mean living non-human beings were captured and deliberately put to death.
